name: com.hoonex.solarnet
description: Local-first turn-based multiplayer engine with Nearby and Bluetooth Classic transports, deterministic resync, room/lobby lifecycle, two-phone diagnostics, and a networked 2D sample.

samples.description: Two-phone Android diagnostics for Nearby, Bluetooth Classic, room lifecycle, and turn packets.
Playable 5x5 two-player game with both local LoopbackTransport and two-phone Nearby/Bluetooth Classic demos.
